relatedEntities.name: Metformin hydrochloride tablets
relatedEntities.notes: Common DP form — formulation process is a separate recipe modality

properties.appearance: White solid (often handled as hydrochloride salt API)
properties.solubility: Free base and HCl salt are highly water-compatible relative to many APIs

hazards.notes: Cyanoguanidine / dicyandiamide and dimethylamine hydrochloride chemistry involves toxic and irritant materials. HCl salt formation is strongly acidic. Confirm intermediate SDS packages.

overview: Metformin hydrochloride is produced by reaction of dimethylamine hydrochloride with dicyandiamide (cyanoguanidine) under heat, followed by isolation of the biguanide hydrochloride. It is a high-volume, relatively short-step API process with strong emphasis on impurity control (including nitrosamine risk management in modern quality systems) and salt form consistency.
manufacturingSummary: Heated condensation of DMA·HCl with dicyandiamide in suitable medium; crystallization of metformin HCl; drying. Corrosion-resistant equipment for hot HCl-containing media. Modern plants maintain formal nitrosamine control strategies.

environmentBaseline.atmosphere: Closed systems preferred for amine vapors
environmentBaseline.notes: Hot acidic amine chemistry: glass-lined or appropriate alloy; elastomer compatibility for HCl.

ehsHighlights: Dimethylamine: flammable gas / aqueous solutions — odor and exposure control
Nitrosamine control strategy for API (quality/regulatory expectation)

routes.name: Dicyandiamide + dimethylamine hydrochloride (industrial standard)
routes.summary: Thermal condensation of dimethylamine hydrochloride with dicyandiamide yields metformin, isolated as the hydrochloride salt. Simple BOM, high volume, quality focus on related biguanide impurities and modern nitrosamine controls.
routes.overallYieldTypical: Good commercial yields with optimized hold profiles (package-dependent)

materials.name: Process solvent / neat melt packages exist
materials.notes: Many industrial descriptions heat the salt mixture; confirm licensed package

steps.title: Condensation to metformin
steps.description: Charge DMA·HCl and dicyandiamide (and solvent if used). Heat to process temperature with good mixing. Hold until conversion IPC is met. Control foaming and vapor evolution.
steps.mechanismNotes: Dimethylamine adds into the cyanoguanidine framework to construct the biguanide core of metformin. Mechanistic details depend on protonation state and medium; industrially treated as a high-temperature condensation with well-defined impurity maps.

environment.notes: Thermal oil jackets common for >100 °C service.

steps.scaleNotes: Heat-up rates and wall temperatures affect impurity formation—instrument thoroughly at pilot.

steps.title: Crystallization of metformin HCl and finishing
steps.description: Cool / add antisolvent or aqueous crystallization medium per package. Isolate metformin hydrochloride, wash, dry. Optional recrystallization for impurity rejection.

cqaTargets: Nitrosamine risk controls per current guidance

steps.scaleNotes: Define purge capability for specific impurities; document nitrosamine control strategy explicitly.

routes.isolation: Centrifuge or filter-dryer; dry under vacuum; mill if needed for formulation.

scaleUp.labToKilo: Glass-lined reactor with thermal fluid; scrubber mandatory.
scaleUp.kiloToPilot: Map impurity vs heat history; introduce formal cleaning validation for multi-product plants.
scaleUp.pilotToCommercial: High-volume crystallization trains; continuous options in modern designs.
scaleUp.safetyScaleUp: Amine vapor exposure, HCl corrosion, thermal runaway screening of condensation.
scaleUp.greenChemistryNotes: Short route is inherently lean; focus on solvent recovery and energy integration.

sourceRefs.label: Process chemistry literature on metformin HCl

disclaimer: Not a validated GMP procedure. Nitrosamine and impurity controls must follow current regulatory expectations and site quality systems.
